description: NYC Department of Finance Digital Tax Map condominium tables (unit lot to billing lot) for the FactLot Registry collector. See docs/registry/data-policy.md, docs/registry/collection.md, and the review record in docs/registry/sources/ny-nyc-dof-condo.md.

sources.publisher: New York City Department of Finance (via NYC Open Data)
sources.license: Published on NYC Open Data under the NYC Open Data Law (Admin. Code §23-502). NYC Open Data FAQ: 'Open Data belongs to all New Yorkers. There are no restrictions on the use of Open Data.'
sources.ai_use: Not addressed by the publisher; the FAQ states there are no restrictions on the use of Open Data
sources.redistribution: Permitted: 'no restrictions on the use of Open Data' (FAQ). Attribution: New York City Department of Finance, Digital Tax Map
sources.notes: Digital Tax Map: Condominiums (p8u6-a6it, one row per condominium with its billing-lot BBL) and Digital Tax Map: Condominium Units (eguu-7ie3, one row per unit lot with its condominium key). Only BBL and key columns are requested (no condominium name, unit designation or geometry). The Tyler/Socrata platform terms are in tension with bulk export (see ny-nyc-dof and docs/registry/requests/platform-terms/socrata.md); the agency licence is relied on. data.cityofnewyork.us robots.txt: Crawl-delay 1; only /browse search pages disallowed.
